title: Purple Mage Warrior
description: A young female character with long white hair and purple eyes stands in a dynamic combat pose. She wears a white and purple traditional outfit with a halo of glowing purple energy above her head, holding a large purple crescent moon weapon in one hand while casting a glowing purple orb with the other.
prompt: A fierce young woman with long flowing white hair and glowing purple eyes, wearing a white and purple traditional East Asian inspired battle outfit with sashes and armor details, stands in a dynamic fighting stance. She holds a large purple crescent moon blade in one hand and casts a swirling purple energy orb with the other. A glowing purple halo of magical sparks floats above her head. Clean anime style with sharp lines and vibrant colors on a solid gray background.
